root_idea.summary: The root contains several divergent lexical branches: spinning and spun thread, amatory speech and conduct, distraction in pursuit, and the gazelle branch with related names for the sun.
root_idea.development: Classical analysis treats these branches as distinct rather than deriving them all from one direct principle. The name غَزَالَةٌ for the sun is explained as a possible metaphor from rays resembling spun cords.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The sole Quran-attested group is displayed under the normalized noun غَزْلٌ.

senses.definition: Spun thread or yarn, the product of spinning.
senses.usage_conditions: In 16:92, غَزْلَهَا denotes the yarn that she had spun and that is then undone; the Quranic occurrence is a product noun rather than the act of spinning itself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To engage in amorous and enticing speech or conduct with a woman or women.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form I verb; the usage concerns the conduct or talk of a lover with the object of love.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a dog, to become distracted, slack, or perplexed after reaching a young gazelle, and turn away from the pursuit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized usage describing failure or diversion in the pursuit of a gazelle.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To converse or act amorously; to dally, sport, or behave wantonly with someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form III. The same verb may be extended figuratively to dally with pleasant circumstances or ease of life.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To approach the age of forty.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional idiomatic usage of the Form III verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To turn, revolve, or twirl a spindle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form IV; the spindle may itself be described as having been made to revolve.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a female gazelle, to have a young one.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A lexical Form IV usage applied to the gazelle.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To undertake or affect ghazal: to engage in amorous expression or to speak of a beloved, especially in poetry.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form V; it can denote adopting the subject or style of amatory discourse rather than direct amorous interaction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To exchange amorous speech or conduct; to dally or flirt with one another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form VI reciprocal usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A spider’s web.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported extended application of the noun for spun material.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In Egyptian usage, a kind of food identified with إِطْرِيَة.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Regional and technical usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A follower or lover of women; a man devoted to amorous dealings with women.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression is also explained as one who talks or acts amorously with women.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Amatory discourse and conduct: the talk, actions, and circumstances between a lover and the beloved; by extension, love poetry or mention of the beloved.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This literary term includes amorous expression but is distinguished in some usage from تَشْبِيبٌ and نَسِيبٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An amorous man, or one fond of women and displaying amorous behavior.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used as a possessive or descriptive epithet for someone associated with غَزَل.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Weak, remiss, or languid in carrying out or accomplishing things.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate adjectival usage, not restricted to amorous conduct.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Relating to spun thread or yarn.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Relational adjective derived from غَزْلٌ used as a substantive.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A young gazelle; غَزَالَةٌ is reported as its feminine form.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Lexicographers differ over the precise age and sex covered by غَزَالٌ, ranging from a young gazelle to a gazelle more generally.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A certain locust-like insect.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized zoological expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A plant resembling tarragon, eaten for its pungency and also used to make red streaks on the arms.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plant name, not a reference to the animal’s blood.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The sun, especially its disk or rays; in some usage, the rising or elevated sun.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term is explained as referring to the sun’s cord-like rays; some authorities restrict it to the sun when rising or high.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The beginning or early part of the forenoon.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional time expression, extending from sunrise into the early ضُحَى period.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sweet, pasture-growing herb with green leaves and yellow blossoms.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A regional plant name for a spreading, edible herb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A spinner or seller of spun thread or yarn.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An occupational noun associated with غَزْل.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who spins.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Active participle of غَزَلَ; its plural forms may also be used as epithets for women and, in one form, for men.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In proverbial comparisons, more skilled at weaving, more accomplished in love poetry, more recurrent in visiting, or more confused and perplexed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The interpretation depends on the comparison: weaving and love poetry preserve the spinning or amatory branches, while recurrent visiting and confusion are figurative applications.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A spindle, the instrument used for spinning; variant forms may also denote the place of spinning or the place on which yarn is put.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The forms and vocalizations vary by dialect and lexical analysis; the spindle is the primary instrumental sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The upright supports of a threshing machine.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized plural usage of مِغْزَلٌ and its variants.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who pares or trims spindles.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An occupational or technical relational noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A term reported for a slender cord and, in a variant reading, for a slender mountain or place-name.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The lexical reading is textually unstable; the cord interpretation is explicitly reported, while a manuscript reading supports the mountain interpretation.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Spinning and its product are covered by the Quranic yarn sense.

cautions: The term مُغَيْزِلٌ is textually unstable in the supplied evidence: it is reported as a slender cord, while a manuscript reading supports a slender mountain or place-name.
